session_summary: Follow-up session focused on reviewing a completed between-session task (recording journey times) and conducting an in-session activity comparing recorded times with the timetable. The student confirmed completion of the agreed task but reported that the wider barrier (uncertainty about route approval/safety) remains unresolved. No external support (e.g., formal transport assessment or route verification) has been delivered yet.

tracked_details.detail: Main barrier: Uncertainty about whether an approved alternative route exists; anxiety regarding a specific crossing point.
Intended intervention: Transport Assessment to identify safer routes or entitlements.
Delivered activity: Mapping the usual route and identifying difficult points (connection) during the session.
Agreed between-session task: Record two actual journey times before the next meeting.
Student preference: School-based next steps rather than home-based solutions; avoiding sharing private family details in records.

next_steps: Verify status of transport entitlement or alternative route approval.
Student to attempt checking an alternative departure and writing down whether it is practical before the next meeting.
Review recorded data and adjust plan (school-based step) in next session.
uncertainties: Whether an approved alternative route exists.
conclusion: The second session successfully reviewed the completion of the agreed between-session task (recording journey times) and conducted a comparative analysis with the timetable as an in-session activity. The student reported that while the specific step was manageable, the main barrier regarding route uncertainty and safety remains unresolved. No external support services have been delivered or received. Evidence supports that the mentoring session itself was helpful for clarifying steps, but it does not establish improvement in the primary barrier or attendance. The intended intervention (formal Transport Assessment) remains pending.
